key_insight: CodeMidas turns existing source code itself into a large supply of executable RL environments for training coding agents. This expands task diversity beyond what issue trackers and commits can provide.
problem_solved: Training coding agents with reinforcement learning needs many diverse, reliable tasks with verifiable outcomes. Existing approaches often depend on development artifacts like issues and commits, which limit scale and miss many useful tasks hidden inside codebases.
method: Uses an agentic pipeline to extract implemented functionality directly from open-source codebases.
Converts that functionality into executable RL environments with built-in verifiers.
Scales environment generation from source code rather than relying only on external development artifacts.
impact: This makes it easier to build broader, more realistic training data for coding agents. For practitioners, it could improve agent robustness, coverage of coding tasks, and the efficiency of RL-based training pipelines.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: codebase -> task extraction -> RL environment -> verifier

paper_title: CodeMidas: Scaling Agentic Coding RL Environments from Code Itself
paper_authors: Bowen Ye, Lei Li, Shicheng Li, Zihao Yue, Linghao Zhang
